TopHeavy.CommandText:
SELECT "t1"."TelegramId", "t1"."Balance", "t1"."JoinedAt", "t1"."NotificationOn", "t1"."Username", "p"."Id", "p"."AcquiredAt", "p"."AverageBuyPrice", "p"."AverageReservePrice", "p"."AverageSellPrice", "p"."CharacterTokenId", "p"."Quantity", "p"."ReserveQuantity", "p"."SellingQuantity", "p"."TraderTelegramId", "t0"."Id", "t0"."AverageExecutePrice", "t0"."CharacterTokenId", "t0"."CreatedAt", "t0"."ExecutedAt", "t0"."FilledQuantity", "t0"."Price", "t0"."Quantity", "t0"."Status", "t0"."TraderTelegramId", "t0"."Type"
FROM (
    SELECT "t"."TelegramId", "t"."Balance", "t"."JoinedAt", "t"."NotificationOn", "t"."Username"
    FROM "Traders" AS "t"
    WHERE "t"."TelegramId" = @__traderTelegramId_0
    LIMIT 1
) AS "t1"
LEFT JOIN "PortfolioItems" AS "p" ON "t1"."TelegramId" = "p"."TraderTelegramId"
LEFT JOIN "TradeOrders" AS "t0" ON "t1"."TelegramId" = "t0"."TraderTelegramId"
ORDER BY "t1"."TelegramId", "p"."Id"

SELECT "c"."Symbol", "c"."CreatedAt", "c"."CurrentPrice", "c"."IconUrl", "c"."ImageUrl", "c"."IsActive", "c"."Name", "c"."Rarity", "c"."TotalSupply"
FROM "CharacterTokens" AS "c"
WHERE "c"."Symbol" IN (
    SELECT "a"."value"
    FROM json_each(@__activeSymbols_0) AS "a"
)
